summary: Re-tested P0 iteration_286 scope on backend+frontend. Backend core contracts passed (template /use, tenant-default preference, set-default guard for unknown placeholders). Frontend confirms 3 output buttons only and no WhatsApp secondary preview modal, but QuickPrint broken-default flow still fails with generic error, and WhatsApp valid-phone path is blocked by unresolved outbound variables.

critical.issue: Template with [[CUSTOMER_NAME]] is accepted as valid default, but frontend renderer does not replace [[...]] syntax, causing unresolved placeholders to leak into QuickPrint/DocumentPrint runtime.

minor.issue: For valid phone scenario, response still returns missing_variables (observed: SEAL_CODE, WORKSHOP_PHONE), which blocks WhatsApp open route from UI even when number is complete.

ui_bugs.issue: With incomplete default template, quick-print-error is generic (e.g., تعذر إنشاء المعاينة بالقالب المختار) and does not reliably list missing variables in Arabic as required.
Invoice group renders two cards with active styling (tenant + system defaults) while showing one badge only; badge rule is correct, but active-card dual highlight remains visually confusing.

integration_issues.issue: Preview iframe is not rendered; WhatsApp/PDF actions do not produce wa.me/PDF and user sees generic failure instead of actionable missing_variables list.
No wa.me open occurred in test run because message resolution returns missing_variables; with no phone, guard message works correctly.

issues: Dual 'active' visual state for tenant/system defaults can still confuse managers despite single displayed default badge

action_items: Unify placeholder policy end-to-end: either reject [[...]] at set-default validation OR support replacing [[VAR]] in renderDocumentTemplate (QuickPrint + DocumentPrint).
In QuickPrint, always show missing_variables list in quick-print-error (Arabic) when template completeness fails; do not fallback to generic message.
Fix outbound message template/data so required variables (SEAL_CODE, WORKSHOP_PHONE) are always provided before WhatsApp open path.
Keep only one clear effective-default visual state in templates-group-invoice (not only badge logic).
critical_code_review_comments: Validation/render mismatch is root cause: backend accepts placeholders that frontend renderer does not resolve, creating runtime failures after successful default assignment.
WhatsApp integration is blocked by outbound missing_variables contract even with valid phone; this is an integration/data contract issue, not selector automation noise.
No mocked APIs detected; failures are from real integrated flows.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary templates during UI/API retest: ITER287_SAFE_UI, ITER287_PDF_UI, ITER287_BROKEN_UI, ITER287_BROKEN_API (kept archived/overridden as part of regression flow).
context_for_next_testing_agent: At end of run, default invoice template for tenant default/ar-SA was restored to ID 3666c919-4cd3-4ee3-91ef-dff5cfd5bf41 via API. Reproduce blocker quickly by setting template 0ec0770a-4048-4c88-8832-91558b63dea1 as default then opening QuickPrint from operations card print action.
rca of the issue: RCA: set-default validation allows [[CUSTOMER_NAME]] because variable name itself is known, but frontend rendering utilities replace only {{VAR}} and {VAR}. Result: template is marked valid/default yet remains unresolved at runtime, causing QuickPrint/DocumentPrint generation failures and generic UI errors. Secondary blocker: outbound message resolve still requires SEAL_CODE and WORKSHOP_PHONE; if these are absent in payload/workshop data, WhatsApp route (wa.me/share) is intentionally blocked even with valid phone.
